_comment: ISOLATED item-drops lane: consumable crafting recipes (combine N drop materials -> 1 consumable). Loaded by DeNelle.Village.Items.ConsumableCraftingCatalog via DeNelle.Core.CanonicalJson (Resources first, StreamingAssets fallback). This is a SEPARATE file from the dungeon-side crafting-recipes.json (which CraftingRecipeCatalog owns) so the two never collide. A recipe's 'output' is a consumable id from consumables.json AND the VillageInventory larder key it deposits. DARK by default (gated by ItemDropSystem.Enabled): the crafting service no-ops until the flag is on. Placeholder content - OWNER + CREATIVE finalise the real material roster, costs and output magnitudes.

_schemaNotes.recipes: Each recipe combines the listed ingredient materials (drop ids from loot-tables.json) into one output consumable (id from consumables.json). Craftable once the larder holds at least every listed count.
_schemaNotes.ingredients: { id, count } - id is a drop-material larder key; count is how many are consumed.
_schemaNotes.output: The consumable id produced (deposited 1 into the larder).
